title: 橋面超高性能混凝土接縫
subcategoryTitle: 橋梁耐久、檢測與健康監測
subcategoryTitleEn: Bridge durability, inspection and health monitoring
summary: 從快速橋梁施工中預鑄橋面板接縫的荷載路徑出發，說明超高性能混凝土為何能以約 150 mm 寬的接縫完成鋼筋非接觸搭接，量化介面應力、收縮約束、搭接長度與鋼纖維用量，再處理介面粗糙化、模板密封與溢流、流度與強度驗收、接縫性能監測、氯離子耐久與交接維修，並以紐約州 2009 年首批現澆 UHPC 接縫與 2013 年 I-81 雪城四座橋的 10 天封路更換為例。
summaryEn: Starting from the load path through joints between precast deck elements in accelerated bridge construction, explain why ultra-high-performance concrete completes non-contact lap splices in joints about 150 mm wide, quantify interface stress, restrained shrinkage, lap length and steel-fibre content, then cover interface roughening, form sealing and overfill, flow and strength acceptance, joint performance monitoring, chloride durability and handover and repair, using New York's first field-cast UHPC connections in 2009 and the 2013 replacement of four I-81 bridges in Syracuse under 10-day closures.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、吊裝或張拉作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, lifting or stressing permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

stages.title: 工程背景、荷載與結構系統
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「預鑄橋面接縫的荷載路徑」與「收縮、溫差與介面約束」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Load path through precast deck joints" and "Shrinkage, thermal difference and interface restraint": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 預鑄橋面接縫的荷載路徑：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Load path through precast deck joints: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「接縫介面彎曲應力」如何影響橋面超高性能混凝土接縫的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Joint-interface flexural stress” governs force, deformation or durability in “UHPC bridge-deck closure joints”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 快速橋梁施工把橋面拆成預鑄全深度橋面板或帶翼板的預鑄梁，在工廠製作、現場吊裝，再以現澆接縫把它們連成連續的橋面。接縫必須把車輪荷重造成的彎矩與剪力從一塊板傳到下一塊，並長期不透水；傳統做法需要寬接縫讓鋼筋長距離搭接，或以後拉預力壓緊接縫。超高性能混凝土的強度與握裹力極高，使接縫可窄到約 150 mm，鋼筋只需短距離非接觸搭接。但接縫最弱的地方往往不是 UHPC 本身，而是它與預鑄混凝土之間的介面。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「接縫介面彎曲應力」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Accelerated bridge construction splits the deck into full-depth precast panels or precast girders with integral flanges, made in a plant and lifted into place, then joined into a continuous deck with field-cast joints. The joints must pass wheel-load moments and shears from one element to the next and stay watertight for decades; conventional practice needs wide joints for long bar laps or post-tensioning to clamp the joint. UHPC's very high strength and bond allow joints only about 150 mm wide with short non-contact lap splices. Yet the weakest part of the joint is often not the UHPC itself but its interface with the precast concrete. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Joint-interface flexural stress” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：接縫處每米寬負彎矩 M = 25 kN·m/m，板厚 h = 0.2 m，斷面模數 S = b·h²/6 = 1.0×0.2²/6 ≈ 0.00667 m³，σ = M/S ≈ 3.75 MPa；此應力低於 UHPC 約 8.5 MPa 的直接拉伸開裂強度，但已接近一般混凝土與介面的開裂應力，裂縫會先出現在介面。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: With a negative moment at the joint of M = 25 kN·m/m and deck thickness h = 0.2 m, the section modulus S = b·h²/6 = 1.0×0.2²/6 ≈ 0.00667 m³ and σ = M/S ≈ 3.75 MPa; this is below UHPC's direct tensile cracking strength of about 8.5 MPa but near the cracking stress of ordinary concrete and the interface, so cracks appear at the interface first.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「UHPC 強度極高，所以接縫處絕對不會開裂。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "UHPC is so strong that the joint can never crack." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「接縫介面彎曲應力」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Joint-interface flexural stress”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 預鑄橋面接縫的荷載路徑
knowledge.titleEn: Load path through precast deck joints
knowledge.text: 快速橋梁施工把橋面拆成預鑄全深度橋面板或帶翼板的預鑄梁，在工廠製作、現場吊裝，再以現澆接縫把它們連成連續的橋面。接縫必須把車輪荷重造成的彎矩與剪力從一塊板傳到下一塊，並長期不透水；傳統做法需要寬接縫讓鋼筋長距離搭接，或以後拉預力壓緊接縫。
knowledge.textEn: Accelerated bridge construction splits the deck into full-depth precast panels or precast girders with integral flanges, made in a plant and lifted into place, then joined into a continuous deck with field-cast joints. The joints must pass wheel-load moments and shears from one element to the next and stay watertight for decades; conventional practice needs wide joints for long bar laps or post-tensioning to clamp the joint.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：UHPC 強度極高，所以接縫處絕對不會開裂。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: UHPC is so strong that the joint can never crack. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「預鑄橋面接縫的荷載路徑」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Load path through precast deck joints" is correct?
options: UHPC 強度極高，所以接縫處絕對不會開裂。
快速橋梁施工把橋面拆成預鑄全深度橋面板或帶翼板的預鑄梁，在工廠製作、現場吊裝，再以現澆接縫把它們連成連續的橋面。
UHPC 是無收縮材料，不需要考慮收縮與溫差。
optionsEn: UHPC is so strong that the joint can never crack.

Accelerated bridge construction splits the deck into full-depth precast panels or precast girders with integral flanges, made in a plant and lifted into place, then joined into a continuous deck with field-cast joints.
UHPC is a non-shrink material, so shrinkage and temperature need not be considered.
quiz.explanation: 快速橋梁施工把橋面拆成預鑄全深度橋面板或帶翼板的預鑄梁，在工廠製作、現場吊裝，再以現澆接縫把它們連成連續的橋面。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Accelerated bridge construction splits the deck into full-depth precast panels or precast girders with integral flanges, made in a plant and lifted into place, then joined into a continuous deck with field-cast joints. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 預鑄橋面接縫的荷載路徑：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Load path through precast deck joints: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「接縫介面彎曲應力」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Joint-interface flexural stress” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：接縫處每米寬負彎矩 M = 25 kN·m/m，板厚 h = 0.2 m，斷面模數 S = b·h²/6 = 1.0×0.2²/6 ≈ 0.00667 m³，σ = M/S ≈ 3.75 MPa；此應力低於 UHPC 約 8.5 MPa 的直接拉伸開裂強度，但已接近一般混凝土與介面的開裂應力，裂縫會先出現在介面。數值除 UHPC 強度外為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: With a negative moment at the joint of M = 25 kN·m/m and deck thickness h = 0.2 m, the section modulus S = b·h²/6 = 1.0×0.2²/6 ≈ 0.00667 m³ and σ = M/S ≈ 3.75 MPa; this is below UHPC's direct tensile cracking strength of about 8.5 MPa but near the cracking stress of ordinary concrete and the interface, so cracks appear at the interface first. Values other than the UHPC strength are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以有限元素或格梁分析求得接縫位置在車輪荷重、溫度梯度與收縮下的彎矩與剪力，分別檢查 UHPC 本體、介面與預鑄板的應力；接縫位置盡量避開負彎矩最大處，並確認鋼筋穿越接縫的數量足以承受介面開裂後的拉力。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Use finite-element or grillage analysis to find moments and shears at the joints under wheel loads, thermal gradient and shrinkage, checking stresses in the UHPC, the interface and the precast panel separately; avoid placing joints at peak negative moment where possible and confirm that reinforcement crossing the joint can carry the tension once the interface cracks.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 接縫處每米寬負彎矩 M = 25 kN·m/m，板厚 h = 0.2 m，斷面模數 S = b·h²/6 = 1.0×0.2²/6 ≈ 0.00667 m³，σ = M/S ≈ 3.75 MPa；此應力低於 UHPC 約 8.5 MPa 的直接拉伸開裂強度，但已接近一般混凝土與介面的開裂應力，裂縫會先出現在介面。數值除 UHPC 強度外為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: With a negative moment at the joint of M = 25 kN·m/m and deck thickness h = 0.2 m, the section modulus S = b·h²/6 = 1.0×0.2²/6 ≈ 0.00667 m³ and σ = M/S ≈ 3.75 MPa; this is below UHPC's direct tensile cracking strength of about 8.5 MPa but near the cracking stress of ordinary concrete and the interface, so cracks appear at the interface first. Values other than the UHPC strength are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「預鑄橋面接縫的荷載路徑」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Load path through precast deck joints", which statement holds?
options: UHPC 只是強度比較高的混凝土，配比與纖維可以由現場自行調整。
UHPC 可以像一般混凝土一樣用普通模板，漏一點漿不影響品質。
接縫處每米寬負彎矩 M = 25 kN·m/m，板厚 h = 0.2 m，斷面模數 S = b·h²/6 = 1.0×0.2²/6 ≈ 0.00667 m³，σ = M/S ≈ 3.75 MPa。
optionsEn: UHPC is just stronger concrete, so mix and fibre content can be adjusted on site.
UHPC can use ordinary formwork, and a little paste leakage does not matter.
With a negative moment at the joint of M = 25 kN·m/m and deck thickness h = 0.2 m, the section modulus S = b·h²/6 = 1.0×0.2²/6 ≈ 0.00667 m³ and σ = M/S ≈ 3.75 MPa.
quiz.explanation: 接縫處每米寬負彎矩 M = 25 kN·m/m，板厚 h = 0.2 m，斷面模數 S = b·h²/6 = 1.0×0.2²/6 ≈ 0.00667 m³，σ = M/S ≈ 3.75 MPa；此應力低於 UHPC 約 8.5 MPa 的直接拉伸開裂強度，但已接近一般混凝土與介面的開裂應力，裂縫會先出現在介面。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: With a negative moment at the joint of M = 25 kN·m/m and deck thickness h = 0.2 m, the section modulus S = b·h²/6 = 1.0×0.2²/6 ≈ 0.00667 m³ and σ = M/S ≈ 3.75 MPa; this is below UHPC's direct tensile cracking strength of about 8.5 MPa but near the cracking stress of ordinary concrete and the interface, so cracks appear at the interface first. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 預鑄橋面接縫的荷載路徑：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Load path through precast deck joints: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「接縫介面彎曲應力」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Joint-interface flexural stress” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以有限元素或格梁分析求得接縫位置在車輪荷重、溫度梯度與收縮下的彎矩與剪力，分別檢查 UHPC 本體、介面與預鑄板的應力；接縫位置盡量避開負彎矩最大處，並確認鋼筋穿越接縫的數量足以承受介面開裂後的拉力。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Use finite-element or grillage analysis to find moments and shears at the joints under wheel loads, thermal gradient and shrinkage, checking stresses in the UHPC, the interface and the precast panel separately; avoid placing joints at peak negative moment where possible and confirm that reinforcement crossing the joint can carry the tension once the interface cracks. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：接縫設計要分別列出 UHPC 本體、介面與相鄰預鑄板的應力檢核，並說明介面開裂後的傳力假設；接縫位置與方向在預鑄板分割時就與設計者協調，不得由施工方任意調整。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Joint design lists stress checks for the UHPC, the interface and the adjacent precast panel separately and states the load-transfer assumption after interface cracking; joint location and direction are coordinated with the designer when panels are divided and may not be changed by the contractor.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：傳統窄接縫若以一般無收縮砂漿或混凝土澆置，鋼筋搭接不足、握裹力有限，車輛反覆通過後接縫開裂、滲水，鹽水沿裂縫流到梁頂與支承，接縫成為整座橋最先劣化的部位。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Narrow joints filled with ordinary non-shrink grout or concrete have inadequate lap length and limited bond, so repeated traffic cracks them, water leaks through and de-icing brine runs onto girder tops and bearings, making the joints the first part of the bridge to deteriorate. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以有限元素或格梁分析求得接縫位置在車輪荷重、溫度梯度與收縮下的彎矩與剪力，分別檢查 UHPC 本體、介面與預鑄板的應力；接縫位置盡量避開負彎矩最大處，並確認鋼筋穿越接縫的數量足以承受介面開裂後的拉力。
knowledge.textEn: Use finite-element or grillage analysis to find moments and shears at the joints under wheel loads, thermal gradient and shrinkage, checking stresses in the UHPC, the interface and the precast panel separately; avoid placing joints at peak negative moment where possible and confirm that reinforcement crossing the joint can carry the tension once the interface cracks.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 接縫設計要分別列出 UHPC 本體、介面與相鄰預鑄板的應力檢核，並說明介面開裂後的傳力假設；接縫位置與方向在預鑄板分割時就與設計者協調，不得由施工方任意調整。
knowledge.textEn: Joint design lists stress checks for the UHPC, the interface and the adjacent precast panel separately and states the load-transfer assumption after interface cracking; joint location and direction are coordinated with the designer when panels are divided and may not be changed by the contractor.

quiz.question: 要驗證「預鑄橋面接縫的荷載路徑」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Load path through precast deck joints"?
options: 以有限元素或格梁分析求得接縫位置在車輪荷重、溫度梯度與收縮下的彎矩與剪力，分別檢查 UHPC 本體、介面與預鑄板的應力。
量測時不必記錄溫度、日照、風與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
接縫只要表面看不到裂縫，就代表不會滲水。
optionsEn: Use finite-element or grillage analysis to find moments and shears at the joints under wheel loads, thermal gradient and shrinkage, checking stresses in the UHPC, the interface and the precast panel separately.
Temperature, sunshine, wind and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
If no crack is visible on the joint surface, it cannot leak.
quiz.explanation: 以有限元素或格梁分析求得接縫位置在車輪荷重、溫度梯度與收縮下的彎矩與剪力，分別檢查 UHPC 本體、介面與預鑄板的應力；接縫位置盡量避開負彎矩最大處，並確認鋼筋穿越接縫的數量足以承受介面開裂後的拉力。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Use finite-element or grillage analysis to find moments and shears at the joints under wheel loads, thermal gradient and shrinkage, checking stresses in the UHPC, the interface and the precast panel separately; avoid placing joints at peak negative moment where possible and confirm that reinforcement crossing the joint can carry the tension once the interface cracks. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 預鑄橋面接縫的荷載路徑：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Load path through precast deck joints: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「接縫介面彎曲應力」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Joint-interface flexural stress” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 傳統窄接縫若以一般無收縮砂漿或混凝土澆置，鋼筋搭接不足、握裹力有限，車輛反覆通過後接縫開裂、滲水，鹽水沿裂縫流到梁頂與支承，接縫成為整座橋最先劣化的部位。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Narrow joints filled with ordinary non-shrink grout or concrete have inadequate lap length and limited bond, so repeated traffic cracks them, water leaks through and de-icing brine runs onto girder tops and bearings, making the joints the first part of the bridge to deteriorate. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：但接縫最弱的地方往往不是 UHPC 本身，而是它與預鑄混凝土之間的介面。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Yet the weakest part of the joint is often not the UHPC itself but its interface with the precast concrete.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「UHPC 強度極高，所以接縫處絕對不會開裂。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "UHPC is so strong that the joint can never crack." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 傳統窄接縫若以一般無收縮砂漿或混凝土澆置，鋼筋搭接不足、握裹力有限，車輛反覆通過後接縫開裂、滲水，鹽水沿裂縫流到梁頂與支承，接縫成為整座橋最先劣化的部位。
knowledge.textEn: Narrow joints filled with ordinary non-shrink grout or concrete have inadequate lap length and limited bond, so repeated traffic cracks them, water leaks through and de-icing brine runs onto girder tops and bearings, making the joints the first part of the bridge to deteriorate.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「預鑄橋面接縫的荷載路徑」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Load path through precast deck joints" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
傳統窄接縫若以一般無收縮砂漿或混凝土澆置，鋼筋搭接不足、握裹力有限，車輛反覆通過後接縫開裂、滲水，鹽水沿裂縫流到梁頂與支承，接縫成為整座橋最先劣化的部位。
UHPC 是無收縮材料，不需要考慮收縮與溫差。
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.

Narrow joints filled with ordinary non-shrink grout or concrete have inadequate lap length and limited bond, so repeated traffic cracks them, water leaks through and de-icing brine runs onto girder tops and bearings, making the joints the first part of the bridge to deteriorate.
UHPC is a non-shrink material, so shrinkage and temperature need not be considered.
quiz.explanation: 傳統窄接縫若以一般無收縮砂漿或混凝土澆置，鋼筋搭接不足、握裹力有限，車輛反覆通過後接縫開裂、滲水，鹽水沿裂縫流到梁頂與支承，接縫成為整座橋最先劣化的部位。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Narrow joints filled with ordinary non-shrink grout or concrete have inadequate lap length and limited bond, so repeated traffic cracks them, water leaks through and de-icing brine runs onto girder tops and bearings, making the joints the first part of the bridge to deteriorate. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 收縮、溫差與介面約束：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Shrinkage, thermal difference and interface restraint: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「收縮約束應力」如何影響橋面超高性能混凝土接縫的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Restrained shrinkage stress” governs force, deformation or durability in “UHPC bridge-deck closure joints”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: UHPC 水膠比低於 0.25、膠結材含量高，自體收縮比一般混凝土大，長期收縮可達數百微應變；而相鄰的預鑄板早已完成大部分收縮，於是新澆的 UHPC 被兩側舊混凝土約束，在介面產生拉應力。水化熱也使窄接縫在初期溫度較高，冷卻時再增加收縮。若介面黏結不足，這些約束應力會讓介面在通車前就脫開，形成貫穿板厚的細縫，成為日後滲水路徑。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「收縮約束應力」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: UHPC has a water-to-cementitious ratio below 0.25 and a high binder content, so its autogenous shrinkage exceeds that of ordinary concrete and long-term shrinkage reaches several hundred microstrain; the adjacent precast panels have already completed most of their shrinkage, so the new UHPC is restrained by older concrete on both sides and tension develops at the interface. Heat of hydration also warms the narrow joint early, adding shrinkage as it cools. If bond is inadequate, these restraint stresses open the interface before traffic is even applied, forming a fine through-thickness crack that becomes a future leakage path. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Restrained shrinkage stress” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：約束收縮應力 σ = R·E·ε·k。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Restrained shrinkage stress σ = R·E·ε·k.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「UHPC 是無收縮材料，不需要考慮收縮與溫差。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "UHPC is a non-shrink material, so shrinkage and temperature need not be considered." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「收縮約束應力」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Restrained shrinkage stress”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 收縮、溫差與介面約束
knowledge.titleEn: Shrinkage, thermal difference and interface restraint
knowledge.text: UHPC 水膠比低於 0.25、膠結材含量高，自體收縮比一般混凝土大，長期收縮可達數百微應變；而相鄰的預鑄板早已完成大部分收縮，於是新澆的 UHPC 被兩側舊混凝土約束，在介面產生拉應力。水化熱也使窄接縫在初期溫度較高，冷卻時再增加收縮。
knowledge.textEn: UHPC has a water-to-cementitious ratio below 0.25 and a high binder content, so its autogenous shrinkage exceeds that of ordinary concrete and long-term shrinkage reaches several hundred microstrain; the adjacent precast panels have already completed most of their shrinkage, so the new UHPC is restrained by older concrete on both sides and tension develops at the interface. Heat of hydration also warms the narrow joint early, adding shrinkage as it cools.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：UHPC 是無收縮材料，不需要考慮收縮與溫差。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: UHPC is a non-shrink material, so shrinkage and temperature need not be considered. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「收縮、溫差與介面約束」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Shrinkage, thermal difference and interface restraint" is correct?
options: UHPC 是無收縮材料，不需要考慮收縮與溫差。
UHPC 握裹力很強，鋼筋搭接長度可以隨意縮短。
UHPC 水膠比低於 0.25、膠結材含量高，自體收縮比一般混凝土大，長期收縮可達數百微應變。
optionsEn: UHPC is a non-shrink material, so shrinkage and temperature need not be considered.
UHPC bonds so well that lap length can be shortened at will.
UHPC has a water-to-cementitious ratio below 0.25 and a high binder content, so its autogenous shrinkage exceeds that of ordinary concrete and long-term shrinkage reaches several hundred microstrain.
quiz.explanation: UHPC 水膠比低於 0.25、膠結材含量高，自體收縮比一般混凝土大，長期收縮可達數百微應變；而相鄰的預鑄板早已完成大部分收縮，於是新澆的 UHPC 被兩側舊混凝土約束，在介面產生拉應力。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: UHPC has a water-to-cementitious ratio below 0.25 and a high binder content, so its autogenous shrinkage exceeds that of ordinary concrete and long-term shrinkage reaches several hundred microstrain; the adjacent precast panels have already completed most of their shrinkage, so the new UHPC is restrained by older concrete on both sides and tension develops at the interface. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 收縮、溫差與介面約束：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Shrinkage, thermal difference and interface restraint: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「收縮約束應力」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Restrained shrinkage stress” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：約束收縮應力 σ = R·E·ε·k。E = 48 GPa、長期收縮 ε = 555×10⁻⁶、約束度 R = 0.3、潛變鬆弛係數 k = 0.5：σ = 0.3×48,000×555×10⁻⁶×0.5 ≈ 4.0 MPa，低於 UHPC 開裂強度約 8.5 MPa，但可能超過未粗糙化介面的黏結強度。數值除材料性質外為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Restrained shrinkage stress σ = R·E·ε·k. With E = 48 GPa, long-term shrinkage ε = 555×10⁻⁶, restraint R = 0.3 and creep relaxation factor k = 0.5: σ = 0.3×48,000×555×10⁻⁶×0.5 ≈ 4.0 MPa, below UHPC's cracking strength of about 8.5 MPa but possibly above the bond strength of an unroughened interface. Values other than material properties are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以材料試驗取得 UHPC 的收縮曲線（例如規定 28 天收縮上限），在接縫中埋設振弦式應變計與溫度計記錄初期溫度與應變；通車前以目視與噴水檢查介面是否有細縫，並在第一個冬季後再檢查一次。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Obtain the UHPC shrinkage curve from material tests (for example against a specified 28-day limit), embed vibrating-wire strain gauges and thermometers in the joint to record early temperature and strain, and check the interface for fine cracks visually and by water spray before opening and again after the first winter.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 約束收縮應力 σ = R·E·ε·k。E = 48 GPa、長期收縮 ε = 555×10⁻⁶、約束度 R = 0.3、潛變鬆弛係數 k = 0.5：σ = 0.3×48,000×555×10⁻⁶×0.5 ≈ 4.0 MPa，低於 UHPC 開裂強度約 8.5 MPa，但可能超過未粗糙化介面的黏結強度。數值除材料性質外為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: Restrained shrinkage stress σ = R·E·ε·k. With E = 48 GPa, long-term shrinkage ε = 555×10⁻⁶, restraint R = 0.3 and creep relaxation factor k = 0.5: σ = 0.3×48,000×555×10⁻⁶×0.5 ≈ 4.0 MPa, below UHPC's cracking strength of about 8.5 MPa but possibly above the bond strength of an unroughened interface. Values other than material properties are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「收縮、溫差與介面約束」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Shrinkage, thermal difference and interface restraint", which statement holds?
options: 約束收縮應力 σ = R·E·ε·k。
UHPC 黏結力很強，預鑄介面平滑也沒關係。
UHPC 一定很強，只要按配比拌合就不必做驗收試驗。
optionsEn: Restrained shrinkage stress σ = R·E·ε·k.
UHPC bonds so strongly that a smooth precast interface does not matter.
UHPC is always strong, so batching by the recipe makes acceptance testing unnecessary.
quiz.explanation: 約束收縮應力 σ = R·E·ε·k。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Restrained shrinkage stress σ = R·E·ε·k. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 收縮、溫差與介面約束：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Shrinkage, thermal difference and interface restraint: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「收縮約束應力」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Restrained shrinkage stress” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以材料試驗取得 UHPC 的收縮曲線（例如規定 28 天收縮上限），在接縫中埋設振弦式應變計與溫度計記錄初期溫度與應變；通車前以目視與噴水檢查介面是否有細縫，並在第一個冬季後再檢查一次。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Obtain the UHPC shrinkage curve from material tests (for example against a specified 28-day limit), embed vibrating-wire strain gauges and thermometers in the joint to record early temperature and strain, and check the interface for fine cracks visually and by water spray before opening and again after the first winter. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：規格書要列出 UHPC 收縮上限、澆置時的氣溫與預鑄板表面溫度範圍、初期養護方式（封閉保濕至初凝），並禁止以熱風直吹新澆表面；接縫監測計畫在設計時就納入。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: The specification lists the UHPC shrinkage limit, air and panel-surface temperature ranges for casting and early curing (sealed and moist until initial set), and forbids forced hot air on fresh surfaces; joint monitoring is planned at design.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：在高溫午後澆置窄接縫、又以強風機直吹表面加速乾燥，UHPC 表面失水並劇烈收縮，介面在數天內脫開；外觀上接縫完整，但雨水與鹽水沿介面細縫滲入，數年後下方梁頂出現鏽水與白華。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Casting a narrow joint on a hot afternoon and blowing forced air across it dries the surface and drives severe shrinkage, opening the interface within days; the joint looks intact, but rain and brine seep along the fine interface crack and rust staining and efflorescence appear on the girder tops below within a few years. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以材料試驗取得 UHPC 的收縮曲線（例如規定 28 天收縮上限），在接縫中埋設振弦式應變計與溫度計記錄初期溫度與應變；通車前以目視與噴水檢查介面是否有細縫，並在第一個冬季後再檢查一次。
knowledge.textEn: Obtain the UHPC shrinkage curve from material tests (for example against a specified 28-day limit), embed vibrating-wire strain gauges and thermometers in the joint to record early temperature and strain, and check the interface for fine cracks visually and by water spray before opening and again after the first winter.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 規格書要列出 UHPC 收縮上限、澆置時的氣溫與預鑄板表面溫度範圍、初期養護方式（封閉保濕至初凝），並禁止以熱風直吹新澆表面；接縫監測計畫在設計時就納入。
knowledge.textEn: The specification lists the UHPC shrinkage limit, air and panel-surface temperature ranges for casting and early curing (sealed and moist until initial set), and forbids forced hot air on fresh surfaces; joint monitoring is planned at design.

quiz.question: 要驗證「收縮、溫差與介面約束」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Shrinkage, thermal difference and interface restraint"?
options: 沿用另一座橋或另一棟建築的量測結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
以材料試驗取得 UHPC 的收縮曲線（例如規定 28 天收縮上限），在接縫中埋設振弦式應變計與溫度計記錄初期溫度與應變。
UHPC 不透水，所以整條接縫及其周邊都不會發生腐蝕。
optionsEn: Reusing results from another bridge or building counts as verifying this structure.

Obtain the UHPC shrinkage curve from material tests (for example against a specified 28-day limit), embed vibrating-wire strain gauges and thermometers in the joint to record early temperature and strain, and check the interface for fine cracks visually and by water spray before opening and again after the first winter.
UHPC is impermeable, so neither the joint nor its surroundings can corrode.
quiz.explanation: 以材料試驗取得 UHPC 的收縮曲線（例如規定 28 天收縮上限），在接縫中埋設振弦式應變計與溫度計記錄初期溫度與應變；通車前以目視與噴水檢查介面是否有細縫，並在第一個冬季後再檢查一次。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Obtain the UHPC shrinkage curve from material tests (for example against a specified 28-day limit), embed vibrating-wire strain gauges and thermometers in the joint to record early temperature and strain, and check the interface for fine cracks visually and by water spray before opening and again after the first winter. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 收縮、溫差與介面約束：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Shrinkage, thermal difference and interface restraint: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「收縮約束應力」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Restrained shrinkage stress” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 在高溫午後澆置窄接縫、又以強風機直吹表面加速乾燥，UHPC 表面失水並劇烈收縮，介面在數天內脫開；外觀上接縫完整，但雨水與鹽水沿介面細縫滲入，數年後下方梁頂出現鏽水與白華。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Casting a narrow joint on a hot afternoon and blowing forced air across it dries the surface and drives severe shrinkage, opening the interface within days; the joint looks intact, but rain and brine seep along the fine interface crack and rust staining and efflorescence appear on the girder tops below within a few years. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：若介面黏結不足，這些約束應力會讓介面在通車前就脫開，形成貫穿板厚的細縫，成為日後滲水路徑。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: If bond is inadequate, these restraint stresses open the interface before traffic is even applied, forming a fine through-thickness crack that becomes a future leakage path.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「UHPC 是無收縮材料，不需要考慮收縮與溫差。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "UHPC is a non-shrink material, so shrinkage and temperature need not be considered." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 在高溫午後澆置窄接縫、又以強風機直吹表面加速乾燥，UHPC 表面失水並劇烈收縮，介面在數天內脫開；外觀上接縫完整，但雨水與鹽水沿介面細縫滲入，數年後下方梁頂出現鏽水與白華。
knowledge.textEn: Casting a narrow joint on a hot afternoon and blowing forced air across it dries the surface and drives severe shrinkage, opening the interface within days; the joint looks intact, but rain and brine seep along the fine interface crack and rust staining and efflorescence appear on the girder tops below within a few years.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「收縮、溫差與介面約束」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Shrinkage, thermal difference and interface restraint" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
UHPC 握裹力很強，鋼筋搭接長度可以隨意縮短。
在高溫午後澆置窄接縫、又以強風機直吹表面加速乾燥，UHPC 表面失水並劇烈收縮，介面在數天內脫開。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
UHPC bonds so well that lap length can be shortened at will.
Casting a narrow joint on a hot afternoon and blowing forced air across it dries the surface and drives severe shrinkage, opening the interface within days.
quiz.explanation: 在高溫午後澆置窄接縫、又以強風機直吹表面加速乾燥，UHPC 表面失水並劇烈收縮，介面在數天內脫開；外觀上接縫完整，但雨水與鹽水沿介面細縫滲入，數年後下方梁頂出現鏽水與白華。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Casting a narrow joint on a hot afternoon and blowing forced air across it dries the surface and drives severe shrinkage, opening the interface within days; the joint looks intact, but rain and brine seep along the fine interface crack and rust staining and efflorescence appear on the girder tops below within a few years. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.
